description: This file contains implementation of DM-RS (Demodulation Reference Signal) helper functions for 3GPP NR (New Radio) specifications, including pattern definitions, parameter tables for different DMRS types, and functions to generate sequences and retrieve parameters based on DMRS type and port.

methods.name: dmrs_sequence_generate
methods.description: Generates DM-RS sequence based on resource block mask, PRNG, amplitude, reference point, and DMRS per resource block.

methods.name: get_pxsch_dmrs_params
methods.description: Retrieves the physical resource block scrambling parameters for a given DMRS type and port index.
